channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: LA Firefighters Battle Vacant Duplex Fire
item.description: The New Orleans Fire Department extinguished a two-alarm fire at a vacant duplex on Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.

item.title: ID Firefighter, Deputies Honored With Medals of Honor After Canfield Shooting
item.description: Four men in Idaho are being honored for their heroism during the Canfield shooting, which resulted in the deaths of two firefighters and left another paralyzed.

item.title: NY Firefighter Injured Battling House Fire
item.description: A house fire in Auburn on Tuesday morning injured one firefighter and displaced two residents.

item.title: CT Protesters Demand Resignations of Fire Chief, City Manager in Dispute Between Career and Volunteer Departments
item.description: Norwich volunteer firefighters protested for the resignation of City Manager John Salomone and Fire Chief Sam Wilson, citing public safety concerns and tax increases from the shutdown of Yantic Fire Engine Co. No. 1.

item.title: Il Firefighters Battle Early Morning Shopping Center Fire
item.description: An early morning fire destroyed part of the Wilshire Village Shopping Center in East Alton, with multiple fire departments responding.

item.title: Severe Floods in Southeast Brazil Kill at Least 25 and Force Hundreds to Evacuate
item.description: Severe floods in Minas Gerais, Brazil, have resulted in at least 25 deaths and 43 missing persons, with more rain expected. Rescue efforts are ongoing amid warnings of mudslides.

item.title: 11 People Rescued from Three-Alarm Fire at Five-Story CT Apartment Building
item.description: A three-alarm fire in a New Haven apartment building resulted in the rescue of eleven people.

item.title: Making the Move from Captain to Probie
item.description: Host Frank Ricci interviews Danny Stratton about making the move from the Camden (NJ) Fire Department to the Philadelphia Fire Department.

item.title: Firefighter Rescue Survey and The First 5,000
item.description: What are the best ways to use data from the Firefighter Rescue Survey Update? Find out from Command Show hosts Anthony Kastros and Brian Brush. Sponsored by Tablet Command.

item.title: Firefighters from Six Departments Respond to NY Farmhouse Fire
item.description: A two-story house fire in Lyon Mountain required 20 firefighters from six departments and over 60,000 gallons of water to extinguish. All residents escaped safely; Red Cross is assisting them.
